subject: Pilot evaluation: defining KPIs, token economics & ops ownership
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@hyperledger.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Follow-up from demo — pilot goals and initial asks

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call earlier — the product walkthrough was helpful. Our engineering team reviewed the examples and we want to move toward a short pilot to validate production characteristics. High-level goals: reduce inference cost for our summarization pipeline and validate predictable latency under mixed traffic.

A few asks to get us moving:
- Can you share a proposed POC plan (timeline, checkpoints, who-owns-what)?
- Draft success criteria (latency, throughput, cost/token, quality) we can align on.
- Any data/format requirements for the sample traffic we'll upload.
- Procurement contact for SOW and billing (I loop Tom in below).

Preliminary targets from our side (for discussion):
- Latency: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms for 512-token sequences
- Throughput: sustain 40 req/s with bursts to 120 req/s
- Cost: target < $0.0025 per token (end-to-end)
- Quality: human eval Top-1 accept rate >= 88% for our 200-sample set

We have an NDA in place (attached).

If possible, can you send a one-pager POC plan by next Tue so we can align internally?

Best,
Alice
Senior ML Product Manager
Hyperledger AI

Attachments: nda-hyperledger-signed.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@hyperledger.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — pilot goals and initial asks

Hi Alice — great to hear you want to move forward. Draft POC outline attached (redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf) and I included a small sample CSV schema (hyperledger_traffic_sample.csv) so your eng team can map fields quickly.

Summary (short):
Phase A — Kickoff & smoke validation (week 0–1)
- Redwood provides a sandbox endpoint and config template.
- Upload 1k sample requests; we run smoke validation to confirm parsing and output shapes.
- Owner: Hyperledger: Alice (data); Redwood: Ben (SE).

Phase B — Load & quality evaluation (week 2–3)
- Run steady-state traffic replay to measure latency/throughput; include bursts to simulate peak.
- Run curated quality suite (200 samples): automated metrics + 10% manual review.
- Owner: Redwood: Monica (CS) to run quality rubric; Hyperledger: eng lead to triage model outputs.

Phase C — Cost tuning & handoff (week 4)
- Apply batching/quantization profile and measure tokens-per-second vs cost.
- Produce runbook and dashboard for production handoff.

Proposed concrete success criteria (suggested, negotiable):
- Latency: p50 < 70ms, p95 < 250ms (512-token median workload)
- Throughput: sustain 45 req/s, tolerate 110 req/s burst for 30s without error spikes
- Cost: baseline deployment cost < $0.0020 / token (1k-token normalized unit) after tuning steps
- Quality: automated accept rate >= 90% on curated set; manual review <= 10% deflection

Measurement notes:
- Latency measurements will be instrumented at request ingress and egress; p95 computed across 5-minute windows during steady-state runs.
- Cost/token computed using tokens emitted + infra amortization for the run (we provide a reproducible cost sheet).
- Quality is a combined metric: automated metrics (ROUGE, exact match when applicable) + blind manual labels on a 200-sample set.

Attachments included: redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf (POC plan), hyperledger_traffic_sample.csv (schema).

Proposed kickoff: Tue Sep 14, 10:00 AM PT — 30–45 minutes to align owners and SOW asks. Ben will scope the capacity estimate; Monica will own the success dashboard and runbook. Tom, can you advise on procurement cadence/required SOW components?

Next steps:
- Ben: attach capacity & cost estimate (by Sep 8)
- Monica: share dashboard templates and acceptance rubric
- Alice: confirm kickoff time and share 1k sample ELT by Sep 10

Thanks — happy to iterate.

—
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships (Sales)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf, hyperledger_traffic_sample.csv
From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@hyperledger.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@hyperledger.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — pilot goals and initial asks

Hi team — thanks for the plan. Procurement side: we need a short SOW (1–2 pages) with deliverables, timeline, and an estimate. Also please share SOC2 report or a link to compliance docs. We can do a short PO or a SOW + invoice depending on pricing.

Questions:
- Can you provide a ballpark cost for the 4-week pilot (including the capacity you propose)? We prefer an all-in number we can sign off quickly.
- Billing terms: Net 30 OK?
- If there's any data residency or retention controls in the pilot, note them in SOW.

I've attached our procurement template and the key contact is procurement@hyperledger.ai — please send the SOW there.

Tom Becker
Head of Procurement
Hyperledger AI

Tom — appreciate the clarity. Quick update and consolidation: 

- SOW & ballpark: Ben (cc'd) will attach a concise SOW and a single-line ballpark cost by EOD Sep 10. Expect an all-in pilot estimate (capacity + engineering support). Net 30 is fine.
- Compliance docs: Monica will share SOC2 link and a short summary of data retention controls for the pilot (we will not persist raw customer inputs beyond 30 days unless you opt-in).
- Measurement & gating: we will produce a short acceptance checklist tied to the KPIs in the POC plan; Monica will own the acceptance dashboard and run the weekly readout.

Confirmed owners:
- Redwood: Ben Carter (SE, capacity & SOW), Monica Patel (CS, dashboard & acceptance)
- Hyperledger: Alice Nguyen (data & product owner), Tom Becker (procurement)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Ben posts SOW + ballpark pricing to procurement@hyperledger.ai (Sep 10 EOD).
2) Alice uploads 1k sample traffic (per CSV schema) to the shared Drive link (by Sep 10).
3) Kickoff meeting: Tue Sep 14, 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to go out from Ben.

If that all looks good, we'll send the SOW and calendar invite today/tomorrow.
